qualification.qml_lazy_popup: passed actual headless Wayland lifecycle: creation, focus, retained drafts and view switching
resolved_harness_issues: Legacy desktop ISO boot did not start Anaconda after the installer-only default was added. Qualification now starts it when absent and preserves an already running installer; two regression cases pass.

Installed-console bootstrap now retries a visibly empty login prompt at most three times if the initial username input is lost during a VT switch; tests verify recovery and failure without sending a secret.

The network-blocked saved-choice ISO fixture invoked online reconfiguration, which attempted Fedora metadata downloads. It now uses the supported --offline policy mode; regression tests cover offline invocation and bounded redacted diagnostics.

Concurrent installer initialization can briefly lock keyboard selection. The browser driver now retries only the explicit busy response, with bounded attempts/deadline; four JavaScript regression cases cover recovery, exhaustion, other errors and an expired deadline.
